Bug_Details:
Scope annotation on implementation class of AssistedInject factory is not allowed Classes that AssistedInject factories create may not be annotated with scope
annotations, such as @Singleton. This will cause a Guice error at runtime. See
this bug report
for details.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the MyService class. It is annotated with @Singleton, which is not allowed for classes that are created by AssistedInject factories. This will cause a Guice error at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the MyServiceFactory creates a new instance of MyService, which is annotated with @Singleton. This violates the rule that classes created by AssistedInject factories cannot be annotated with scope annotations.
